tools.name: check_compensation
tools.description: Assess one disrupted flight under EU261/UK261: works out which scheme applies (or none), route distance and band, whether fixed compensation is due and how much (EUR/GBP), care rights, the stated reason's effect, and next steps. Use for 'what am I owed for my flight?'. Do NOT use to write the claim;

tools.name: compensation_table
tools.description: Return the general EU261/UK261 reference: compensation amounts per distance band (EUR and GBP), when care starts, the main eligibility rules and claim time limits. Use when the user asks how the rules work or what the amounts are. Do NOT use to assess a specific flight; use check_compensation.

tools.name: disruption_rights
tools.description: List passenger rights for a disruption: first works out whether EU261/UK261 covers the route (as check_compensation does), then gives refund/re-routing, care by band, 5-hour refund, notice-based cancellation compensation rules, denied boarding and escalation. If no scheme applies, gives general guid

tools.name: claim_timeline
tools.description: Give claim-deadline guidance for a flight under EU261 or UK261: a recommended act-by date (flight date + 12 months), the legal time-limit guidance, and an evidence checklist. Use for 'how long do I have to claim?'. Do NOT use to check eligibility; use check_compensation.

tools.name: generate_claim_letter
tools.description: Draft a formal EU261/UK261 compensation claim letter (subject, legal basis, amount, 14-day payment request, escalation notice) for the passenger to send themselves, plus sending tips.
